# Jooble LLM Integration Links
> Curated list of useful links for job seekers and partners on Jooble.

Official and helpful resources from Jooble.org.

## Home page
- [Jooble - 1.303.000 current vacancies - Jobs in USA](https://jooble.org/): Search jobs from verified employers across the USA and abroad.

## For Employers & Partners
- [Job aggregator in USA, post jobs on Jooble](https://jooble.org/partner/ppc): How to post jobs via XML feed and drive traffic to your listings.
- [ATS Integration Guide](https://jooble.org/ats): Integrate your ATS and get your jobs listed on Jooble.
- [Affiliate Program | Jooble](https://jooble.org/affiliate/): Earn revenue by publishing job postings via our affiliate program.
- [For Publishers](https://jooble.org/partner/for-publishers): Collaborate with Jooble as a content publisher or aggregator.

## About Jooble
- [About us Jooble](https://jooble.org/info/about): Learn about Jooble's mission, history, and global reach.
- [Leadership Team - Jooble](https://jooble.org/leadership/): Meet the people behind Jooble's vision and strategy.
- [Press Room](https://jooble.org/press): Access our media kit and corporate news for journalists and PR.

## For Jobseekers
- [Free Jooble CV Builder](https://jooble.org/cv-builder): Build your resume and apply in one click.
- [Download Jooble Mobile Apps | Jooble](https://jooble.org/mobile/): Get the app and never miss a job alert.
- [Salary Comparison, Search Salaries on Jooble](https://jooble.org/salary): Compare salaries based on your skills and location.
- [Job Descriptions](https://jooble.org/job-description/): Understand what different jobs require through real descriptions.
- [Jobseeker reviews](https://jooble.org/jobseeker-reviews): Learn how other users found success using Jooble.

## Careers at Jooble
- [Join Jooble Team](https://jooble.org/hiring): Become part of Jooble's mission to help people find jobs.

## Career Resources & Insights
- [Jooble Career Guide](https://jooble.org/career-advice/): Labor market research, recruitment insights, and tips.
- [Jooble Blog - News](https://jooble.org/insights/): Read news and thought pieces on jobs and employment trends.

## Company & Legal Info
- [Terms of Service](https://jooble.org/info/terms): Read Jooble's terms and conditions for using the platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://jooble.org/info/privacy): Learn how Jooble protects your data and privacy.
- [Contacts](https://jooble.org/info/contacts): Get in touch with Jooble support or offices.

## Platform Resources
- [Jobs by Categories](https://jooble.org/categories): Browse jobs grouped by industries and specializations.
